operational_failures_at_freeze.recovery: A bounded Node inventory read the same exact skill paths and reported byte and line counts without changing any file.
operational_failures_at_freeze.subject: A read-only PowerShell skill-inventory projection placed a pipeline immediately after a foreach statement and failed with an empty-pipe parser error.

operational_failures_at_freeze.recovery: One bounded Node JSON projection read all five complete UTF-8 documents; the failed wrapper retained zero credit.
operational_failures_at_freeze.subject: A second PowerShell wrapper repeated the same foreach-to-pipeline parser shape while combining five skill documents.

operational_failures_at_freeze.recovery: A literal Node directory walk examined only four declared candidate roots and found Mira's exact phase bank.
operational_failures_at_freeze.subject: A candidate-path inventory repeated the same invalid foreach pipeline shape before external receipt discovery.

operational_failures_at_freeze.recovery: Mira's exact immutable final contains a committed 731-byte v15 authorization copy; its hash and contents were verified while the missing shared copy remains an explicit current-reference gap.
operational_failures_at_freeze.subject: The shared family-index reference directory does not contain the current-authorization-v15.json file named by the v15 authorization skill.

operational_failures_at_freeze.recovery: A schema-first probe enumerated the exact keys, after which the bounded validator checked all 210 workflow rows against all 45 weighted roster positions.
operational_failures_at_freeze.subject: The first v15 control validator assumed the roster used an assignments array and raised TypeError because the roster correctly uses roster_positions.

operational_failures_at_freeze.recovery: A bounded scalar Node Git probe verified clean state, 0/0 divergence, four-way equality, direct ancestry, zero merges, 1,413 tracked files, and 128 owner files.
operational_failures_at_freeze.subject: The first composite Mira source-equality probe completed without a visible result projection.

operational_failures_at_freeze.recovery: No planning artifact or domain session was created; the assertion now requests --untracked-files=all so the exact file path is visible before one bounded planning retry.
operational_failures_at_freeze.subject: The first planning invocation compared Git's default collapsed untracked-directory status against the literal phase.txt path and rejected the otherwise correct initial state before creating plan.json.
